samples.provenance: Wheel SHA-256 equals the digest published at https://pypi.org/pypi/toolpass/0.11.0/json; purpose corroborated by https://github.com/roee-hersh/toolpass
execution_paths: __init__.py exports library APIs; no install-time launcher or hidden payload.
_api.py _Remote.check posts permission queries only to caller/environment configuration; TLS is required outside loopback; redirects refused.
_wire.py observe -> _check -> _authorize maps instrumented HTTP calls to session permissions and refuses unauthorized actions before invoking the original transport.
_record.py emit -> target -> _Sender queues audit records only when an explicit endpoint and API key are configured; no fixed external collection host.
_watch.py starts a token-protected loopback HTTP page on explicit watch(); watch.js updates local UI state and fetches the page API.
cli.py passes an explicitly requested command to subprocess.call with an argument vector; _checks.py eval resolves caller-supplied Python type annotations.
authx helpers perform documented OAuth/JWT/SigV4 authentication; Base64, key handling, and cloud API tables are ordinary SDK functionality.
samples.dependency_review: No hostile finding originated in fetched dependency code; corrections target the actual generic matchers, without a Toolpass identity exclusion.

execution_paths: Top-level loop selects a writable staging directory; stops, disables and masks aegis/aliyun/YDService/tat_agent services.
Clears immutable/append-only flags, kills AliYunDun/YDService, recursively deletes /usr/local/aegis and /usr/local/qcloud.
download_vos uses uname -m in http://23.160.56.223/new.php?type=<arch>; wget/curl, renamed clients and inline urllib write the same target variable.
Successful download -> chmod +x "$target" -> setsid "./$target"; fallback launches the same file through sh. Payload was not downloaded or executed during review.
lock_tools renames resolved wget/curl paths to good/cool; later commands stop firewalld/ufw, flush iptables and truncate wtmp/btmp/lastlog.
samples.changes: Move removal to impact/degrade/services; require deletion of a security-agent directory. Move payload result to execution, requiring security-removal admission plus fetch and launch observations. Add neutral computed-destination rename observation.

samples.method: Statically decoded CLR tables and all CIL method bodies with dnfile/dncil; no sample execution.
execution_paths: CLR entry token 0x0600007a -> j.A.main -> j.OK.ko. .cctor configures 33.tcp.cpolar.top:11182, a Run-key path, and NjRAT 0.7d Horror Edition banner.
j.OK.ko starts j.kl.WRK; WRK polls virtual keys 0..255 with GetAsyncKeyState, Fix/VKCodeToUnicode translates them, AV adds foreground-window context, and Logs retains the result.
j.OK.RC receives TCP bytes and dispatches j.OK.Ind. The kl command reads kq.Logs, Base64-encodes it through ENB, then calls Send -> Sendb -> socket Send.
Ind rn command obtains bytes from DownloadData or a GZip wire body, writes a generated temporary path with WriteAllBytes and launches that exact local path with Process.Start.

Ind screenshot handler calls CopyFromScreen, encodes JPEG, and passes the image bytes to Sendb. Cam only enumerates devices through capGetDriverDescriptionA; do not infer camera image capture from it.

Ind can call Stub.MBRSlayer.Start, which initializes a 512-byte boot-sector buffer, opens PhysicalDrive0 with generic-all access, and writes that same buffer/handle through WriteFile. A command can reboot afterward.

Plugin loads received bytes via Assembly.Load then Assembly.CreateInstance. ReadAllBytes elsewhere reads the current executable for installation/copy; FromBase64String elsewhere decodes wire strings. They do not form an adjacent encoded-sidecar chain.

Defender disabling, browser/process termination, scheduled-task persistence and Run-key modification exist as configurable functions; disabled builder options are capabilities, not proof they ran. Pastebin rendezvous is disabled in this build.
samples.changes: Retire unsupported whole-file staging and HTTP keylog-channel intersections; retain keylog/network co-occurrence as suspicious collection. Require actual njRAT stub evidence in the anti-Defender identity. Disable generic Winnti/campaign/unknown-malware signatures that only match shared strings; native references and behavior remain.

placement.method: Review exact-ID consumers and ancestor selectors. Exact consumers follow supported facts; objective-directory selectors intentionally cease inheriting generic SDK or syntax observations. New rules use existing admitted leaves. No sample/package allowlist added.
scope_changes: Shell cloud-agent and admitted payload rules now target Linux shell rather than generic scripts on every Unix platform.
The original AWS header OR is decomposed into canonical SigV4, target-header and token-header observations; a Python-scoped group preserves the old consumer union and exclusions.
Mappings preserve constituent matchers; attack mappings are removed from neutral observations.
Existing context-only literal fragments outside the reviewed moves remain in their grandfathered namespaces pending the documented migration contract.
coverage_changes: Agent deletion must target the actual protection directory; a path mention plus unrelated cleanup no longer suffices.
RAT family attribution requires stub reply/install identity. Screen collection requires polling-keylog recording and no longer claims webcam capture or C2 from enumeration and networking alone.
GetObject is a generic member-name reference, not proof of managed-resource access. Timer+Forms co-occurrence no longer claims a WinForms timer.
The Python bytes(member) operation is neutral buffer construction, not an embedded PE. History API updates carry no forgery claim.

controls: Run check.py with --scratch-dir pointing at the session scratch directory. Eight source controls test SDK/headers, buffer materialization, listener scope, ordinary routing, plugin-host false conviction, security-agent payload admission and unrelated cleanup. Retained regression expectations for back-button traps, AWS CLI markers and service-loader atoms are updated to canonical IDs.

existing_controls.browser navigation: 6/6 passed; stale SPA expectation corrected to match saved-state exclusion already present in the rule
